$comment: GENERATED MIRROR of backend/src/permissions/catalog.js. Do not hand-edit: change the backend catalog, then run npm run lint:permissions to see what drifted. The descriptions are carried across so this file is readable on its own.

capabilities.business:create: Start another business under the same account. FRONTEND VISIBILITY ONLY — the POST /businesses endpoint is deliberately ungated, because it runs before the business exists and has no tenant to check a capability against. See the note in business.controller.js
capabilities.branch:create: Add a branch to the business
capabilities.branch:update: Change a branch: timezone, coordinates, punch-in geofence
capabilities.branch:allAccess: Act across every branch without a BranchAccess row. This is the DATA scope only — see the note on staff:viewAllBranches
capabilities.team:view: See who belongs to this business, and the pending invites
capabilities.team:invite: Invite someone and choose their role and branches
capabilities.team:revoke: End someone's access, or withdraw a pending invite
capabilities.team:manageBranchAccess: Widen or narrow which branches a member can reach
capabilities.staff:update: Edit, deactivate or reactivate an employee record
capabilities.staff:viewOthers: Read a colleague's employee record, not just your own
capabilities.staff:viewAllBranches: Read any branch's employees. Deliberately SEPARATE from branch:allAccess: the warehouse desk ships to every branch and has no business reading their HR records
capabilities.staff:setPay: Set or change someone's base salary
capabilities.attendance:markOthers: Mark a colleague present, absent, half-day or on leave
capabilities.attendance:viewRoster: See a branch's attendance roster for a day
capabilities.attendance:punchAnywhere: Punch in and out away from any branch. For a job with no fixed location: the geofence is not applied, and in exchange the coordinates become REQUIRED rather than optional, so where and when is always on the record
capabilities.payroll:view: See generated payslips other than your own
capabilities.workCalendar:manage: Change the weekly off and the holiday list — these set the payroll divisor
capabilities.dataSource:manage: Connect a data source and upload sales files
capabilities.product:manage: Add, edit and deactivate products, and price them per branch
capabilities.counterOrder:create: Open a counter order and issue a token
capabilities.counterOrder:edit: Change a counter order after it was placed
capabilities.counterOrder:void: Void a counter order, removing it from the day’s sales
capabilities.counterOrder:closeDay: Close a branch's day, after which its orders can no longer be edited
capabilities.supplyItem:view: See the raw-material catalog and what the warehouse charges for it
capabilities.supplyItem:manage: Add, price and withdraw raw material. The warehouse decides what it stocks, so a cashier who orders from the catalog deliberately cannot edit it
capabilities.supplyOrder:view: See supply orders. WHAT is seen depends on the role and is enforced separately: the warehouse desk sees every branch (requirement 3), a delivery agent sees the run they are carrying, a cashier sees their own branches
capabilities.supplyOrder:create: Cart raw material and place an order on the warehouse; cancel it while the warehouse has not accepted it yet
capabilities.supplyOrder:fulfil: Accept, pack and dispatch a supply order; hand it to a delivery agent and see who is free to take it; forward a company-operated branch’s vendor order to the vendor; reject one the warehouse cannot fill
capabilities.supplyOrder:deliver: Carry a supply order and mark it delivered, taking the cash or showing the warehouse’s UPI QR when it is paid on delivery
capabilities.supplyOrder:delay: Post a delay against an order, with a reason
capabilities.supplyOrder:receive: Confirm that goods from a third-party vendor arrived at the branch. A vendor does not use the app, so the branch is the only one who can say so
capabilities.supplyPayment:settle: Pay for a company-operated (FOCO) branch’s supply orders once they are delivered — one order or a whole batch to the same payee at once
capabilities.supplyPayment:verify: Confirm the warehouse received a franchise branch’s payment, or say it did not. Split out of supplyOrder:fulfil so accounts can confirm money without being able to run the desk
capabilities.supplyPayment:viewHistory: Read the history of supply-order payments — what accounts paid for company (FOCO) branches and what franchise (FM) branches paid — month by month (requirement 35). Deliberately NOT held by the warehouse desk, which confirms payments but does not keep the books
capabilities.paymentAccount:manage: Set or change the UPI IDs payments go to — the counter’s, the warehouse’s and every vendor’s. Deliberately NOT held by the warehouse desk: whoever can change where money goes must not also be whoever ships the goods
capabilities.expense:view: Read a branch's spending and its category breakdown. Separate from expense:log because the back-office desk reads every branch's figures and records none of them, and separate from expense:viewAllBranches because WHICH branches is a question of scope, not of whether you may look at all
capabilities.expense:log: Record what a branch spent, by category
capabilities.expense:classify: Decide whether an expense category is a variable, fixed or day-to-day cost in Reports (requirement 34). Not part of expense:log: whoever records spending may add a category, but how the owner's report sorts it is the owner's
capabilities.expense:viewAllBranches: See every branch's expenses, and which ones have logged nothing today
capabilities.analytics:viewBranch: See a branch's own sales, costs and totals
capabilities.analytics:viewToday: See today's sales, bills and spending at the branches you reach — the figures at the top of Home (requirement 33). Narrower than analytics:viewBranch: no costs, wages or profit, which is why a cashier holds this one and not that
capabilities.analytics:viewBusiness: See every branch compared, month by month, with net profit
capabilities.export:dayEnd: Export everything entered on a given day
capabilities.export:monthEnd: Export everything entered in a given month
capabilities.billing:manage: See this business's plan, what it unlocks and when it renews. The owner's alone, like starting a business: an admin runs the business they were given, and its bill is not part of that

plans.$comment: GENERATED MIRROR of backend/src/permissions/plans.js (requirement 28). What each subscription plan unlocks: capabilities, features no capability can express, and the roles a business on it may invite. Cheapest first. Prices are deliberately not here.
